dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The First" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! I am here again! Where are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The First" Itto
dialogues.text: "I will never forget that you took my Vision away. As long as I still breathe, I will keep coming for you!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Everyone, no need to worry! The Tenryou Commission will handle this vandal soon.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou Sara promises that she has nothing to do with this person. Please do not worry.
